headline: This law awards Congressional Gold Medals to the U.S. Capitol Police and D.C. Metropolitan Police for protecting the Capitol on January 6, 2021.
what_it_does: The law authorizes Congress to give Congressional Gold Medals to the U.S. Capitol Police and the Metropolitan Police Department of the District of Columbia. The medals honor the law enforcement agencies that protected the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021. The title describes four medals in total.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on August 5, 2021.
